trial.a: When you sign up you activate the chosen plan with no immediate charge. You get a verification email and full access during the trial. After it ends, set up PayPal to continue.

paypal.q: How do I pay after the trial?
paypal.a: Subscription is managed securely via PayPal. You can cancel anytime from your billing panel.

email.q: Do I need to verify my email?
email.a: Yes. For security we send a verification link when you register. Without verification, panel access stays limited.

plans.a: Yes. From billing you can upgrade or downgrade as your church needs change.

cancel.a: Yes, with no penalty. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

reino.q: What does Kingdom plan include today?
reino.a: Higher limits, audit logs, and dedicated support. External API and multi-site are on the roadmap and marked Coming soon.
